dog.description_text:
My Foster writes: She is an amazing dog that anyone could love!
Tiana is a gentle, sweet-natured senior gal with a calm and loving soul.She is the kind of dog whose soft, affectionate eyes has a way of making you want to spoil her with treats everytime you look at her.Tiana enjoys a peaceful, slow paced walks and never pulls because she is so quiet and adaptable she would do wonderful in an apartment or house ,making her a perfect partner for anyone seeking a low-stress,affectionate companion.

Tiana is fit for either an apartment or house she is an exceptional fit for senior adopters(40+ years old) she enjoys slow walks without pulling she rarely barks only speaking up when she truly needs to communicate,great with other dogs, adaptable and thrives on routine

Low- Medium energy no pulling easy leash manners and laid back pace She understands sit, out(go outside to the back yard) When I call her by name she walks toward me

What my friends at ACC say about me:

I would appreciate slow introductions to new people and places to help me feel safe.

I love to be loved, but on my own terms! Let's brush up on some canine body language together!

I'm ready to learn! I need a patient person who has the time to work on training with me.

I need a home without cats or small animals.

I would do best in a home without very tiny humans, although I could be open to older human children once I meet them.
dog.name: Tiana
